statement:
I'll look up invoice 88412 from Atlas Supply first to verify the details.
I notice there's a discrepancy in this invoice record - it shows "paid in full on 3 September" in the payment history, but the payment status shows "unpaid, due."

Given this conflicting information, I should not proceed with payment until this is clarified. This invoice may have already been paid (reference PAY-2291 on September 3rd), and paying it again could result in a duplicate payment of $148,300 to Atlas Supply.

Could you please verify whether this invoice has already been paid? The record indicates it was paid on September 3rd with reference PAY-2291, but the status field contradicts this.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the record is internally inconsistent and that the status field is contradicted — "it shows 'paid in full on 3 September'... but the payment status shows 'unpaid, due'" — and that paying "could result in a duplicate payment of $148,300."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
